Hello there!

I hope you're enjoying your first few days on Exercism.
As you continue to explore our platform, I wanted to take a moment to tell you about our amazing community.

Exercism is an open-source, community-powered project.
In fact, we're one of the biggest open-source organisations on GitHub with over 350 repositories.
Our community is centered around our values of empathy, kindness, and inclusivity.
Check out this video or read more below 👇

We have several community areas that you might find interesting and enjoyable:

- Our Discord channel is the place to go to hang out with the Exercism community, join community calls, and get quick support.
- Our forum is a great place to ask longer-form questions, share ideas, and connect with others who are passionate about coding.
- Our YouTube Channel is the space to find our best video content — educational walkthroughs, Exercism updates, community stories, and interviews with industry experts.
- On Twitch, we host live streams featuring both our community and guests from the coding ecosystem.

We would love for you to join in and become an active member of our community.
Whether you're a seasoned developer or just starting out, there is a place for you here.
So don't be shy, come say hello and get involved!

Best regards,

Jeremy Walker
Exercism Co-founder & CEO

body:
Hi Elliott-

My name is Sloan and I am the recruiter for the Headphone and Accessories team at Apple. I noticed you recently applied for a Tools & Automation Engineering role in San Diego. My hiring manager would be interested in having an introductory chat with you. Can you let me know when you would be available over the next couple of weeks for a 30 minute WebEx call and I can have my coordinator start the scheduling?

Thank you.

-Sloan

Headphones and Accessories Tools & Automation Engineer

Job Summary

Join our Sensing and Connectivity team and drive innovation that matters. We craft and seamlessly integrate technologies that enrich people’s lives and deliver the best user-experience. The Headphones and Accessories Quality Engineering team is looking for a motivated Tools & Automation Engineer to design, implement, test and maintain next generation audio and connectivity solutions. You are responsible for creating and delivering world changing experiences on the very latest Apple products.

Key Qualifications

Must be proficient in a coding language (Python, Java, Objective C, C++, etc)
Highly motivated, dedicated, quick learner with recognized ability to work individually and as a team.
Consistent track record in defining robust test plans and delivering high quality outcomes.
Experience designing, developing robust and scalable automation frameworks using industry standard methodologies.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and documentation skills.
Efficient time management and organization, ability to handle multiple tasks and thrive in a fast paced environment.
Laser-focused on the smallest details that are meaningful to our customers.
Self-motivated, dedicated with validated creative and critical thinking capabilities, strong troubleshooting skills.
Obsessively passionate and inquisitive, and seek to pursue everyday problems in innovative ways.
Strong understanding of development methodology and object oriented programming concepts.
Experience building automation setups for testing embedded devices for various mobile operating systems.
Domain expertise in one of these areas preferred: Bluetooth, WiFi, Audio, Wireless RF protocols.
Experience with hardware communication interfaces such as USB, UART, I2C, SPI.
Experience with source control (Git, GitHub Flow, Gitlab, SVN, Perforce).
Experience on Continuous Integration tools like Jenkins is a plus.
Experience building/creating/using Robotics to create automated solutions.
Good Knowledge on database concepts.
Passionate about consumer products and technology.

Description

Build creative solutions for testing current and next generation products. Drive quality and champion bug fixes, working closely with dev team and analyze the root causes for the issues. Design comprehensive test plans for new features, factoring in technical details and the customer experience. Develop test automation scripts using Python, maintain reports of all automation issues and test results. Collaborate with cross functional teams to get requirements and implement automation feature requests. Bring up, perform regular maintenance and debugging of test setups and scripts.

Education

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Dear Raymond Bian

Thank you for applying to the 129787 Software Developer Spring Co-op 2027 position.

You're invited to complete IBM's recorded competency interview. This short and engaging assessment allows you to showcase your skills beyond a traditional job application.

Please read this email carefully and follow the instructions provided below.

IMPORTANT NOTES:

Please note that being invited to take the assessment does not guarantee progression in the hiring process, and the assessment itself is only one part of the hiring process. Your results will be reviewed with the rest of your application including your skills and experience, and your application may be declined at any point.

If you are successful with the assessment, you will be contacted about next steps. If you are not selected, you will be notified, and you are welcome to apply for other open positions. We appreciate the time you invest in completing this assessment good luck!

1. This interview link will be valid for 7 days, but we recommend completing it as soon as possible.

2. Opening this link will NOT begin the interview process. You will have the opportunity to practice before you begin.

3. This recorded interview will take between 10-20 minutes to complete. You will respond to multiple prerecorded interview questions. For each question you will be given 1 minute to prepare and 3 minutes to respond.

a. Prepare by thinking about your past experiences and accomplishments. Prepare to tell us a bit about the background, action and result. Visit the Candidate FAQ for more tips on how to prepare.
b. This is not a live interview; it is a timed, recorded competency interview.

4. IBM strives to maintain the highest standard of business conduct. Cheating of any kind is prohibited.
a. Prohibited behaviors include leaving the assessment screen, taking screenshots of the content, and plagiarizing your responses.

The assessment has the below basic requirements:

• Please complete your interview in a quiet, distraction free area. Close all other applications and browsers on your computer.
• The interview is compatible with all modern browsers on Windows, Mac OS Desktop, and iOS devices.

Ready to Complete the Interview?

Please click the link below to start your online interview.

[Link to ASSESSMENT]

Good luck with your application,
The IBM Talent Acquisition Team

If you experience any technical issues with the Knockri site, please refer to the FAQ or contact Knockri Support. For all other inquiries, please reach out to IBM Support via the Start@IBM link.
